subject.title: Several latent session/workspace lifecycle concurrency bugs (native-VNC credential leak, run-status stomp, terminal-hub races)

question: Should native-VNC authorization be required to remain valid through the asynchronous grant-mint operation, matching the browser-VNC lifecycle guard?
rationale: The issue identifies a possible credential exposure during teardown, but accepting a fail-closed post-mint check determines an authorization-boundary contract that needs maintainer confirmation before landing the linked repair.

options.title: Adopt the continuous-authorization guard
options.body: Review and land the focused native-VNC repair if its lifecycle checks preserve the intended live-session and control semantics.

options.title: Keep mint-time authorization only
options.body: Document why a grant minted during teardown is acceptable and close the native-VNC subfinding with that explicit contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the continuous-authorization guard
recommendation.body: Review and land the focused native-VNC repair if its lifecycle checks preserve the intended live-session and control semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session-scoped native-VNC feature history most directly connects this person to the authorization and lifecycle contract.
